linkedin-en.title: Thinking Bridge V6 (v6.0.0) — Tuned Like a Six-Cylinder Cognitive Engine
linkedin-en.text:
Just shipped Thinking Bridge V6 (v6.0.0) — The Six-Cylinder Release.

No cloud bloat, no paywalls, no ads, no infinite loading spinners — just a naturally aspirated 100% offline engine built in Alexandria, Egypt for Arabic-speaking learners.

Under the hood — all 6 cylinders firing in sync:
1. Top-5 Languages Track-Verified (EN, DE, FR, ES, TR): 0 gloss/grammar leaks across every dialect including Egyptian Arabic (arz).
2. O(1) Gloss Lookup Map: Replaced 50k-entry linear scans — full audit dropped from ~66s to <1s.
3. Smart Dictionary 10/10 Top-1 Precision: Exact match #1 across all 5 languages + clean BCP-47 TTS.
4. Natural Arabic Copy & 48px Touch Targets: Proper prepositions, RTL arrow mirroring, zero ellipsis truncation.
5. Honor 400 (DNY-NX9) Hardware-Verified: 0 live CDP/CSP errors, 0 overflow even at 150% font scale, and safeVibrate WebView protection.
6. Unified Cross-Platform Build: Web PWA + Signed Capacitor Android APK (versionCode 6000) — 365/365 unit tests passing.

Web App & PWA: https://tb-eg.vercel.app
V6 Release & Signed APK: https://github.com/AmrSherifCodes/Arabic-English-Thinking-Bridge/releases/tag/v6.0.0

#OpenSource #EdTech #OfflineFirst #Android #PWA #Egypt

reddit-en.title: Thinking Bridge V6 (v6.0.0) — 100% Offline, Open-Source Arabic→Language Cognitive App (EN/DE/FR/ES/TR)
reddit-en.text:
Hi everyone! I just shipped Thinking Bridge V6 (v6.0.0) — an open-source, 100% offline-first language-thinking app built in Alexandria, Egypt (inspired by the Language Transfer *Thinking Method*).

Why 'V6'?
We tuned six core subsystems like a six-cylinder engine:
1. Top-5 languages verified (English, German, French, Spanish, Turkish) across Egyptian & MSA Arabic — 0 gloss or grammar leaks.
2. Indexed O(1) gloss lookup map replacing linear 50k-entry scans (cut full audit runtime from ~66s to <1s).
3. Smart Dictionary ranking with 10/10 Top-1 accuracy for everyday core vocabulary + clean BCP-47 offline TTS.
4. Natural Arabic UX, proper RTL mirroring, and >=48px tap targets.
5. Live Honor 400 WebView CDP verification across all 5 languages (0 console/CSP errors, 0 overflow at 150% font scale, safeVibrate intervention guard).
6. 365/365 automated tests passing across PWA and signed Android APK.

Zero ads, zero telemetry, unlimited hearts, AGPLv3 code + CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 content.
Live PWA: https://tb-eg.vercel.app
Release & APK: https://github.com/AmrSherifCodes/Arabic-English-Thinking-Bridge/releases/tag/v6.0.0
